thought.text: Let me trigger an email login to verify the OTP+SMTP path end to end.

reasoning_content: To get clientSchema, I'll trigger init-email-login with client as "dashboard".

action.command: docker run --rm --network workspace_default curlimages/curl:latest -sS -X POST http://backend:4000/api/v1/auth/init-email-login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"client":"dashboard","emailAddress":"admin@schule.de","schoolSlug":"eckener-schule"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"
